A practical reference for SAS programmers writing R. Each topic is one SAS task
shown in R: the call, the output, and where the two languages do not line up.

Search for a SAS name (`MERGE`, `PROC TRANSPOSE`) or pick a topic. The
[cheat sheet](cheatsheet.qmd) is code only.
